name: SF itinerary — ground on non-executable subject
task_prompt: Using bar build make ground falsify, plan a one-day itinerary for a first-time visitor to San Francisco who wants to avoid tourist crowds, prefers walking, and has a vegetarian diet. The subject is the visitor's situation — not executable software. Produce a structured plan only.
notes: Non-software frame. Tests ground token on a non-executable subject: 'run the subject' means 'examine the visitor's situation as it currently stands.' Ground properties: must appear before the plan, formalizing the visitor's constraints. Falsify blind-spot check must adapt to non-executable context — 'Unobservable:' is expected for constraints that cannot be tested by perturbation.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Ground properties:' block appears before the itinerary, containing formal predicates for the visitor's constraints (crowds, walking, vegetarian); (2) formal notation on each property — not prose; (3) atomicity check performed; (4) each itinerary section cites the property it satisfies (e.g. 'satisfies property [2]: walking-only'); (5) 'Unobservable: property [N]' correctly used for constraints that cannot be verified by perturbation (e.g. 'avoids tourist crowds' cannot be executor-tested); (6) 'Coverage: complete' after all properties addressed. All six required for PASS.
